title: The Year Everything Began

shots.image: a college admission booklet on a table in soft morning light, {WOMAN19}'s hand opening it, close view
shots.motion: the booklet opens, camera rises to her
shots.sfx: page turning, morning birds, no music

shots.image: wide establishing shot of an early-2000s Indian college campus with an old stone building, a big banyan tree and students with bags, {WOMAN19} walking in through the gate, seen from behind
shots.motion: she walks through the gate, crane shot
shots.sfx: college ambience, footsteps, birds, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: College opened a completely new chapter in my life.

shots.image: {WOMAN19} walking down an arched college corridor, {FRIEND_COLLEGE} joining her, seen from behind
shots.motion: the friend catches up and they walk together
shots.sfx: footsteps echoing, students chatting, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I met new people, experienced new challenges and began understanding myself better.

shots.image: a college lecture hall with wooden benches, {WOMAN19} writing notes, side view
shots.sfx: lecture murmur, pen writing, no music

shots.image: {WOMAN19} studying in a college library between tall bookshelves, sunlight through high windows, side view
shots.motion: she turns pages, dust glints in the light
shots.sfx: pages turning, quiet library, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I realised that I could learn, grow and take responsibility for my future.

shots.image: {WOMAN19} and {FRIEND_COLLEGE} sitting on the campus lawn under a tree, the friend turning to her, side view
shots.motion: leaves fall gently, the friend asks with a smile
shots.sfx: birds, light breeze, distant students, no music

lines.speaker: FRIEND_COLLEGE
lines.text: So, what do you want to become?

shots.image: {WOMAN19} sitting under the tree hugging her books, looking into the distance thoughtfully, side view
shots.motion: she answers with a hopeful shrug

lines.speaker: WOMAN
lines.text: I want to do something meaningful. I just haven't figured out exactly what yet.

shots.image: {FRIEND_COLLEGE} placing a reassuring hand on {WOMAN19}'s shoulder under the tree, seen from behind
shots.motion: the friend pats her shoulder, both smile

shots.image: {WOMAN19} walking home at sunset along a small stream with reflections, seen from behind
shots.motion: water flows and sparkles, ducks swim
shots.sfx: flowing stream, evening birds, footsteps, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was still discovering what I wanted to become, but one thing was changing.

shots.image: {WOMAN19} at night studying a thick law book with interest at her desk, lamp light, close side view
shots.motion: she turns a page, the camera settles on the book

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I had started believing in myself.
